Horse Handicap v9.97 · Nov 21, 2026

BRIS Single File parser + field-relative win-ranking engine using Prime Power, BRIS speed/pace, class, recent form, trainer/jockey, T/J combo, run style, workouts, surface/distance.

v9.97 · Overlay Board v4.91 · AI(1) Pass Protection
AI(1) pass: When AI(1) has no win bet or extra win play for the horse, Horse Handicap keeps it at PASS. Speed and form evidence remain visible in Race Facts. Existing Horse Handicap checks still apply to AI(1) plays.
Market %: morning-line odds expressed as a share of the active field. The comparison card highlights historical support at AI(1) Chance of 35% or higher when the morning line agrees. If AI(2) ranks another horse first, the comparison shows the two highest AI(1) Chance horses. Historical counts come from a 148-race replay.
Loss signs: Prime Power #1 with zero or one loss sign is highlighted for a qualifying figure favourite. Overlay Board v4.88 reported the pattern in both halves of its historical pool.
Race Facts: career in-the-money percentages now include the number of top-three finishes and starts.
Engine: AI(1) uses Overlay Board v4.91. The new evidence is for review only.

Brisnet .DRF Single File

Reads the Brisnet single-file layout and handles DRF/CSV/TXT content, BOM, CRLF/LF and common delimiters. The picker intentionally accepts any file type so iPhone Files does not hide .DRF files.

BRIS Single File is a comma-delimited data file. If you select a ZIP, this build reads normal files plus multi-entry ZIPs and ZIP data descriptors. If Safari reports an unsupported ZIP compression method, extract the .DRF/.CSV file in Files first.

Equibase RSS / XML Feed

Upload the XML/RSS file or paste its XML contents. The picker accepts any file type so iPhone Files does not hide .RSS/.XML files. Scratch and rider matching is normalized to reduce name-format failures.

Loaded: -
Feed Date: -
Feed Items: -
Price discipline: MODEL SHARE measures relative score strength within the field (M/L fallback for missing form); it is not a win probability or a betting recommendation. v7.74 does not convert it into fair odds or VALUE/UNDERLAY. Final odds remain visible. RSS changes still trigger a full-card recompute and surface reevaluation.
Selection roles: PICK = top selection. BEST requires no serious contradiction. 3/3 = independent concurrence, not automatic BEST. OVERLAY and SECOND LOOK are attention labels, not automatic bets. H2H, pace pressure and surface fit remain visible warnings.
RSS workflow: Apply Feed Updates automatically recomputes all races, reevaluates each horse for the updated surface, and recalculates the model ranking. Before wagering, go to Full Field or Contenders, enter the final odds, then tap Compute Race Card again.
